How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

To get the best results from your Mesa Loop 30oz, here are some tips:

Fill it with your favorite hot or cold drink—its double-walled stainless steel design keeps drinks at the right temperature for hours.
The covered straw lid is leak-proof when locked. Just click the button up or down to lock or unlock it.
The twist-in locking straw means you don’t have to tilt the bottle—just sip upright for easy hydration.
The folding loop handle makes it easy to grab and go, and the silicone base keeps it quiet on hard surfaces.
For cleaning: Disassemble the lid, remove the straw and silicone plug, and place all parts on the top rack of your dishwasher. Let everything air dry thoroughly before reassembling.
